#### 🔀 变更说明 | Description of Change

in:

src/libs/agent-runtime/utils/openaiCompatibleFactory/index.ts

Explicitly set encoding_format: 'float' in the embeddings API request

<!-- Thank you for your Pull Request. Please provide a description above. -->

#### 📝 补充信息 | Additional Information

By explicitly setting encoding_format: 'float' in the API request parameters, we ensure that the response consistently returns numerical arrays in the expected format:

```
const res = await this.client.embeddings.create(
  { ...payload, encoding_format: 'float', user: options?.user },
  { headers: options?.headers, signal: options?.signal },
);
```

fixes #5583 
fixes #7266 

Resolves the errors mentioned here: https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/7266#issuecomment-2816219298

<!-- Add any other context about the Pull Request here. -->

ai_judgment.response: Yes. The issue involves a failure in vectorizing files using an embedding model, which is related to tool invocation or configuration in an LLM-based agent system, aligning with the "Tool-related issues" category in the agent issue taxonomy.
